risk: Aggregate exactness and condition-cell coverage can remain green without proving that a controlled evidence change causes the required invariant or directional behavior. The current suite cannot distinguish genuine evidence sensitivity from unrelated scenario differences or memorized case structure.
bounded_disposition: Freeze four controlled evidence relations before evaluator implementation: an instruction-injection invariance relation and a fresh-to-stale directional-safety relation in both development and held-out test splits. Add only four synthetic counterpart cases, compare exact outcomes, diagnoses, actions, trajectories, and terminal states, and leave the agent, retriever, policy, action set, and authority boundary unchanged.
